palette.role: Primary copy, navigation, and structural hierarchy.

palette.role: Selected states, focus, and deliberate expressive punctuation.

palette.name: Rule
palette.role: Dividers and component boundaries; not small text.

spacing.guidance: Use 16–24px within components, 32px between groups, and 48–64px between larger sections.

layout.name: Cultural poster
layout.guidance: Lead with one expressive typographic gesture, then make dates, location, access, and booking information easy to find.

interaction.guidance: Use restrained transform/opacity reveals to clarify sequence. Keep navigation and actions immediately available; motion should never delay access to content.

components.name: Navigation
components.guidance: Short meaningful labels, a stable wordmark, and one clear next action. Preserve visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Buttons
components.guidance: Ink on paper for primary actions; 2px corners. Minimum 44px touch targets. Accent is available for focus and deliberate selected states.

components.name: Cards & surfaces
components.guidance: Use surface contrast and thin rules for grouping. Keep elevation flat; avoid ornamental shadows.

components.name: Forms & feedback
components.guidance: Persistent labels, readable 16px inputs, inline validation, useful error messages, and honest success states. Never use placeholder text as the only label.
